positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
● Took the proof of concept and developed it into an alpha app using objective-c and swift for iOS, REST and json to communicate with the server, java, jboss, hibernate, mysql on the server side.  Integrated the server with Braintree a 3rd party payment provider. The server was deployed using AWS  - Cloud Computing Services.
● Moved the iOS app through the App Store approval process. 
● Developed the software development process used to deliver value, establish flow and maintain quality. Developed the KanBan board used for tracking development progress. Created a jira template for creating user stories. 
● Trained the product owner on how to be an agile product owner and how to write user stories. Emphasized the concept of focusing on the minimum viable product in an effort to speed up time to market.
● Developed a website version of the iOS app using HTML5, javascript, AngularJS, jquery.js, bootstrap.css, google maps api, REST, ajax, Scalable Vector Graphics(SVG)
● Created a continuous integration pipeline using Jenkins, Gulp.js, Protractor, GIT.  The pipeline in addition to building the website to be deployed to a jboss server also runs unit tests, REST interface tests, end to end tests, jshint, as well as a few other steps to ensure that the application is ready to be deployed.  The git commit is then merged into the master branch if all tests pass.

positions.title: Software Development Manager Global Site Experience
positions.description:
● Led the effort to adopt Agile development practices within the development teams.  Worked with the in house Agile adoption group and the Emergn Agile consultants to develop ways to train the team to not just do agile (scrum/Kanban) but to be agile (philosophical foundation and approach to identifying and solving problems).
● Led the development of the straw man used to update the Software development process followed by the teams.  
● Led the interviewing and then hired the team’s first operational support engineer.
● Managed software developers

positions.title: Head of European Problem Management
positions.description:
● Point of contact for all EU senior leadership team into the Problem management department.
● Advocate/Support for EU concerns into the problem management department
● Advocate/Support for problem management concerns into the EU BU.
● Developed straw man proposal for reconfiguring the problem management structure with a focus on adding global support.
● Managed software developers
● Presented the state of any problems/successes encountered in production as part of a weekly Business Operations Status meeting to the senior executive EU leadership team with a focus on issues related to EU operations.  Deep dived(dove?) into any issues that the team probed.

positions.title: Regional Technology Manager
positions.description:
● Managed software developers
● Interviewed software development candidates via phone screens and in person case studies and behavioral sessions.  Trained software developers in the vistaprint ways.  All in an effort to grow the engineering team in Barcelona from 3 people to 30+ by the time I left Barcelona.
● Trained team members on how to interview and evaluate software engineering candidates.
● Worked with remote core office to develop approach for how to deploy Bcn engineers.
● Enrolled and graduated from the Vistaprint Managerial Development Program (MDP).
● Problem management liaison to the European executive team.
● Presented at the Barcelona Developer's Conference 2011.  Topic: Problem Management - http://blog.claudiu-ursica.ro/2011/11/21/barcelona-developers-conference-2011/

positions.title: Architect
positions.description:
● Managed software developers
● Worked on several projects and operational enhancements focused on improving the ability for marketing to manage the website.  From managing prices on the website to managing the translation process used to maintain the 20 plus websites in over 15 languages.
● Refactored the pricing engine to allow pricing to vary from currency based to locale based.    As the project architect I came up with the design that not only fulfilled the requirements but also fulfilled the requirements of a future project scheduled to take 6+ months of work.  The design allowed the follow on project to only need a few weeks worth of work.
● Developed a pricing test harness to help identify when the refactoring varied from the existing algorithm.  Proved extremely vital as the variation on how pricing is calculated was too numerous to verify with any sort of manual process and too risky to just release to production.  The harness also enabled regression testing with every new release to verify that there were no unintended consequences with the new release.
● Ran training sessions for the EU Marketing department on Problem Management, Software development, and Wiki usage.  The trainings served as an introduction to the different areas of the technology group with an eye towards improving interactions between the different departments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● As a member of the Platform Architecture team focus on providing value to the development organization by optimizing all aspects of the development process.  Including defining, gathering, ratifying, promoting and maintaining architectural standards.  
● Optimize the development process through build management, Software Standards automation, desktop performance optimization, and development statistics tracking.
● Project architect on several projects.  As project architect responsible for design and implementation while adhering to VistaPrint’s architecture standards.
● Consulting architect on several projects.  As consulting architect responsible for external oversight of the architecture of a project. The consulting architect is not a member of the project team, but is accountable to the architecture group and to the VistaPrint Architectural Guiding Principles. 
● Support the development organization by providing design, debugging, and architectural standards support.
● Developed internal project standards used by teams working on projects not targeted for the production environments.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
● As a member of the Marketing Development team focus on providing value to the marketing organization in their day to day tasks.
● Designed and implemented the translation tool used by the organization to translate text for the 16+ languages supported.  Patent pending on the tool’s architecture.
● Reduced team workload by automating various recurring tasks.  Designed and implemented tools that allowed marketing to perform their day to day tasks without requiring development intervention.
● Ran the internal tool presentation to new hires.  Showed how to use the internal tools to update/maintain the website.  Described the various processes and contact points available to affect changes or issues in production.
● As a member of problem management worked to triage and handle any production issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Architect, design and implement reusable C# components and frameworks. Integrate new components with existing core C++ application. 
● Work with all members of the team through the product lifecycle to ensure high quality on time delivery. 
● Plan and schedule project timelines through research, development, QA and deployment. 
● Mentor engineers in OO designs and technologies. 
● Analyze existing C++ software and Oracle database designs. Provide solutions to improve scalablity and reliability. 
● Member of Infrastructure team assembled to handle any high priority production issues. 
● Member of extreme programming team tasked with producing new components with a high level of quality in a short period of time.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
● Lead migration of graduate school websites (Rallyweb.org & Paerweb.org) to new hosting platforms. 
● Assisted graduate school staff in the planning, design, organization and development of sites. 
● Planned and developed data acquisition strategies using .Net technologies. 
● Implemented conference management site.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Lead Developer on the Contrax Product (an n-tier, client/server commercial application). 
● Designed and implemented all new enhancements and functionality using .Net technologies. 
● Managed release engineering of .Net enhancements. 
● Developed GUIs and back end processes using PowerBuilder, SQL, C#, IIS5, Java, Com, DCom, ASP .NET 
● Created customer and detail design documents. 
● Designed algorithms for high throughput processing. 
● Fixed large quantity of existing defects from the project. 
● Improved overall application quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Lead Developer on Wildcat's Online Billing System (An n-tier, client/server application). 
● Generated billings of $26million+ per month while processing 2.5 million rows of online usage data using data warehousing techniques in Oracle. 
● Designed and implemented the Decision Support Website. 
● Integrated the Java billing applications with an Oracle database and an ASP based website. 
● Managed and maintained Oracle 9i database including DBA duties. 
● Created architecture and designs for all Java billing applications. 
● Technical advisor of software design and development process to development team, managers, and end users. 
● Designed and developed the system and unit test infrastructure of the software testing process. 
● Led projects to migrate legacy systems into new billing system.

patents.title: TRANSLATION PROCESSING USING A TRANSLATION MEMORY
patents.description: System and method for tracking and processing of text translations for online use. Translation tasks are submitted along with language and schedule information for translation of primary language text into other languages for use on other language versions of the primary language site or emails. In performing translations, the translator first selects a task group and then translates the individual tasks in the group. A translation memory retains previously translated text and associated translations. When each individual translation task is selected for translation, the translation memory is searched and previously translated identical or similar text and translations are made available for displaying to and use by the translator.

patents.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR TRANSLATION PROCESSING
patents.description: System and method for tracking and processing of text translations for online use. The adding or editing of a text element for a primary language site or a primary language promotional email automatically generates a potential translation task. Potential translation tasks are reviewed and either deleted if no translation is required or organized into groups of related translation items and submitted along with language and schedule information for translation of the primary language text into other languages for use on other language versions of the primary language site or emails. Submission of a translation group generates an automatic notification of pending translation work to the affected translators. In performing translations, the translator first selects a task group and then translates the individual tasks in the group.
